premise: Two fixed, falsifiable M5-to-H4 OHLCV path hypotheses across all twelve existing authenticated Pepperstone annual M5 sources: (1) efficient high-activity four-hour price acceptance persists, (2) high-activity inefficient four-hour path absorbs a late one-hour displacement and reverses. Not a replay of previous volume-dislocation, session-wick, calendar, range-breakout or IPF1 fitted forecasts.

features.fourHourPricePath: log close returns for exact preceding 48 M5 intervals; no forward fill
features.M15: three completed M5 closes, for causal feature provenance and integrity
features.H1: twelve complete M5 bars, last-hour return and tick-volume sum
features.H4: 48 consecutive M5 intervals, signed return, absolute path efficiency
features.D1: observed historical 24h coverage only, not a mandatory bar or fitted signal
features.activityBaseline: prior 20 fully observed H1 tick-volume totals strictly before the four-hour feature interval, last seven days, median; no zero-volume imputation

phase.calendar: 26w development,13w selection,13w exposed audit; audit is globally exposed, not independent
phase.eligibility: only thirteen ex-ante complete exposed audit weeks count for conditional prospectively gated portfolio; never apply HARD21 per candidate

score.multiplicity: 48 fixed symbol-family-horizon tests; one-sided weekly-block Gaussian p with Bonferroni alpha=0.05/48 and >=8 distinct selection calendar weeks; report all tests including missing/negative
score.maturation: no labels crossing phase boundaries; entry is next M5 close and exit exact horizon after entry, unknown remains missing
score.gate: selection signed mean gross >0 and improvement vs fixed 4h momentum >0, weekly-block p <=0.05/48 for both gross and improvement, and gross mean > current observed development adverse nonfinancing bps; never choose audit winner
score.observedTrialClock: 4h UTC closes with exact source-derived M5 continuity; no synthetic sessions or tuned thresholds

economics.currentTermCosts: Original 166 development cost contexts derived from existing authenticated sources; central/adverse/stress are MODELED not historical fills; swap 3x current directional crossing if positively known else no allocation
economics.nativeSelector: --estimate-portfolio-opportunities-batch using existing C# native OpportunityOrchestrator, no second optimizer; modeled bar execution at t+5m only after positive selection gate
economics.missingCosts: No capital allocation on unpriced overnight funding or missing margin/cost; does not stop authentic gross research
